scope.announcement: announce(agent, source, signal?):Promise<void>; an explicit signal cancels waiting and subsequent serial listeners, detaches the exact entry on abort or listener failure, and contains late listener settlement
scope.dispatch: Uses public Cordis events.dispatch(serial) and isBailed with the original scope carrier, callback receiver, listener snapshot and ordering
scope.default: Without a signal, the original ctx.serial and deferred-detach behavior remain unchanged
scope.identity: Entry validation precedes cancellation; exact-entry detach is idempotent and cannot delete a replacement with the same id. Successful completion removes its abort listener
scope.lifecycle: Registry owns only announcement and exact-entry removal; AgentLoop retains Session, Inbox, writer, scope and driver teardown ownership
limitations: Cancellation cannot preempt arbitrary code already executing in a listener; the listener receives the signal and must cooperate for its own side effects
